title: Samosa journeys
description: Players' experience of Samosa, as its README and its game design document describe it.

entities.name: One reign, from confidence to verdict
entities.description: The arc of a session as the game design document lays it out: a reign starts comfortably and usually ends badly.
entities.goal: Rule as long and as well as possible, and get out alive with money in Switzerland if they can.

stages.context: A new reign: a full treasury, every group but the Contras moderately content.
stages.touchpoint: The welcome screen, the treasury and the free first report
stages.action: Reads the best rating to beat, the treasury and State Security's first file.

stages.context: Every month a faction wants something; the treasury drains.
stages.touchpoint: The audience, the adviser and the decision dialog
stages.action: Asks the adviser, then grants or refuses; takes at most one decision from the five sections.
stages.outcome: Some groups like the President more, the one refused less; the reports start to show plots.

stages.touchpoint: The report offer and section 3 of the decision menu
stages.action: Buys reports, pays for secret police, guards or the helicopter, and moves money to Switzerland.
stages.outcome: A stronger guard, a way out, and a Swiss account that only counts if they live.

stages.context: An assassin, an invasion or a revolution.
stages.touchpoint: The alarm, the escape question and the help list
stages.action: Runs, by helicopter or on foot over the mountains, or fights with whichever group still likes them.
stages.outcome: Crushes the revolt and rules on, or the reign ends.

stages.context: Killed, or out of the country.
stages.touchpoint: The funeral (if dead), the rating and the final report
stages.action: Reads the score, line by line, and the best so far.
stages.outcome: A rating to beat next time: different strategies score differently.

entities.name: Climb the high-score table
entities.description: A player signs in, plays a reign, enters it on the table and comes back to see it.
entities.goal: Get a name onto the public table, higher than before.

stages.context: Arrives at the game signed out.
stages.action: Signs in, and is sent back to the game.

stages.context: First time, or out of practice.
stages.action: Presses H for the six pages of how to play, A for About, or S for the table.
stages.outcome: Back at the title, ready to take power.

stages.context: Takes power with any other key.
stages.action: Plays a reign to its end.
stages.outcome: A rating, and the best in this browser.

stages.action: Keeps or types a name of up to 12 characters, on the keyboard or the keys drawn on screen, and presses ENTER.
stages.outcome: The table, with the new reign marked and its rank.
The best 25 reigns, checked by replay, for anyone to see.
